task_name: Acquire and retain German sport fans through a DAZN-led etoro journey
background: The first batch contains 7,000 users in Germany. DAZN is the acquisition hero; the etoro product journey must convert reward-led sign-ups into active, retained investors.
target_audience: 7,000 German sport fans, including users who may be new to investing and are not necessarily from a trading background.
key_message: Get two months of DAZN, understand the short- and long-term benefits available through etoro, and build an investing habit through a six-month sport-led journey.
call_to_action: Copy your DAZN code, then use on DAZN
email_subject: Your 2 months of DAZN and more are waiting
email_preheader: Your €20 reward is applied. Claim your DAZN benefit and see what comes next.
email_opening_paragraph: Your €20 reward is already applied. Copy your DAZN coupon to claim a 2-month free DAZN subscription, use your trading discount and complete the six-month deposit mission to receive all qualifying benefits.

email_journey.name: The benefits are waiting
email_journey.timing: Immediately after V3/qualifying deposit and actual DAZN coupon issuance; target within the first registration week
email_journey.objective: Present the complete benefit stack and drive the next qualifying action
email_journey.hero_message: Get 2 months of DAZN plus more benefits from etoro
email_journey.primary_action: Copy your DAZN code, then use on DAZN; secondary: pick a stock & deposit
short_term_benefits: €20 first-deposit reward when verified as applied
long_term_benefits: 10% promotional bonus on qualifying deposits over six months, up to the approved cap
Recurring investment as a monthly routine

email_journey.name: Claim your DAZN access
email_journey.timing: Day 2–3 after E1; suppress after verified DAZN redemption
email_journey.objective: Help the user copy the coupon and use it on DAZN
email_journey.hero_message: Your 2 months of DAZN are ready to claim

email_journey.name: Build the six-month run
email_journey.timing: Day 5–7; suppress setup instruction when already completed
email_journey.objective: Turn the offer into a repeatable monthly deposit habit
email_journey.hero_message: Keep the benefits moving: deposit €100+ each month

email_journey.name: Keep your place in the season
email_journey.timing: Around day 30 or the next monthly deposit window
email_journey.objective: Reinforce progress and introduce simple product education
email_journey.hero_message: Your next month is part of the plan

references: DAZN Germany plan and pricing page: https://www.dazn.com/de-DE/help/articles/16184063399709-dazn-plane-und-preise
non_investor_value_layer: Start with a manageable amount where current German product terms allow; do not generalize minimums across instruments.
Explain relevant fees plainly and promote low-fee options only when approved for Germany.
Present eligible zero-commission ETFs and recurring investment as a simple monthly routine, not a performance promise.
Introduce CopyTrader with risk and history context, without advice or guaranteed-outcome language.
Offer virtual portfolio or demo mode before users commit real funds.
Mention interest on eligible cash balances only after current rate, eligibility and terms are confirmed.

text_version_by_entity.etoro: Use lowercase etoro in campaign-facing copy, pending brand/legal confirmation.

issues: E1 is gated on V3/qualifying deposit and actual DAZN coupon issuance; define a separate pre-qualification reminder if non-qualified registrants also need email contact.
Confirm the exact DAZN plan, eligibility, redemption flow, duration, and partner terms.
Confirm whether the €20 first-deposit reward is an airdrop, cash credit, or another reward type.
The six-month 10% mechanic must be legally approved in Germany and described as promotional cashback/reward, not guaranteed investment performance.
Confirm whether the qualifying base is deposit amount, invested amount, or both; confirm cap, timing, reversals, and tax treatment.
Confirm German availability and approved positioning for fixed-income products and all promoted assets.
Confirm the DAZN coupon-code source field, delivery timing, one-time-use rules, redemption URL and fallback handling before the email is sent.
Confirm the current 10% bonus cap: the working offer architecture says €500, while an earlier headline suggestion said €300.
